text: can u change the dialog to be to pick the model from the system menu i dont want to type in a path
resolution: Superseded/fulfilled together with req_1617 (same task: pick the import model via the native system file dialog instead of typing a path). Implemented by reusing the existing image-selection door -- zenity --file-selection via execAsync (cutout/sources.ts pickImageFile) -- adding editors/model/pickModelFile.ts (model sibling, *.glb/*.obj filter) and rewiring studiokit/dialogs/ImportModelDialog.tsx to a 'Choose file…' button with the chosen filename shown and Import gated until a file is picked. tsc-check bundles clean. See req_1617 for full detail. Committed e39d8d066.
